purpose: Single source of truth for Carbon League artifacts. Every artifact is registered at creation/landing with name, checksum, machine, path, owner line. Lookups check this registry first; asking lines machine-by-machine for an unregistered artifact is a process failure. Lost artifacts stay registered with status=lost so the loss is never rediscovered by accident.
rules: R1 registry-first: before any transfer or lookup, check this file; register new artifacts in the same turn they land.
R2 single-channel transfer: one batch = one transfer stream = one named executor; never pack/copy from a source that is still being written (torn-copy rule).
R3 release gate: a machine holding unique products is released only after the owning line confirms recovery in writing.
R4 no unique copies in /tmp or on a single spot seat; durable paths only (k0_dist or repo).
